title: Edit box state ignores failures that record no error: photo upload, username premium limit, unknown username problems, type edits
trigger: Edit a group, pick a new photo (or a link that needs Premium) and Save; TDLib refuses the photo or link
effect: record_group_info_edit_error returns without storing for those purposes and state() excludes GroupInfoField::Photo, so the box counts as Saved and closes; nothing anywhere shows the photo error
fix: Track each sent request's result in the box (per-request outcome enum) rather than inferring success from the absence of an error entry.

title: Partial send on Save error leaves some edits applied but untracked
trigger: Save a title change plus a photo where the first request is sent and the next send returns Err
effect: save_group_info stops at the failed edit; what was sent stays sent but the box does not track those ids (saving not set on Err), so no Failed/Saving state shows for them and a retry resends
fix: Return the ids sent so far with the error and keep them in saving.

title: Edit box closes as saved when a second Save fails to send
trigger: Save the group (title refused, box shows Failed), fix nothing and press Save again while save_group_type/save_group_info returns Err (InvalidRequest, no rights, send error)
effect: The first lines of save_group_type clear info_edit_errors; the Err arm keeps the old saving ids, which are answered; state() is now requests gone and no error = Saved, so group_edit_box() reports the box closed (shell closes it) with only an error toast and the edits lost
fix: Make saving an enum field Editing/Saving(ids)/Failed(reason); Err sets Failed in the box itself instead of leaving the old ids to be re-derived.

title: Promote picker 'searched' is set when the search is sent, not when the page lands
trigger: Open Promote admin, type a query and press Search while offline or slow.
effect: The panel switches to the Search page key at once; it shows the previous Search page (cache key is chat+filter, not the query) or Loading, so rows of an older query appear under the new text. Not matched to the query that asked.
fix: Key the member page by (chat, filter, query) and set searched from the answer's query.

title: Promote, edit-rights and demote treat Ok(None) (driver refused) as success
trigger: Demote the owner or press Demote twice quickly (duplicate in flight); promote without the right
effect: submit_admin_dialog matches Ok(_): the dialog is dropped and the note says 'Admin demoted' / 'Member promoted' though nothing was sent (Restrict handles Ok(None) correctly)
fix: Match Ok(Some(_)) as success and keep the dialog with an error on Ok(None), as submit_restrict_dialog does.

title: Restrict, ban, promote and demote dialogs close on send, so a server refusal is not shown in the box
trigger: Ban or restrict a member who cannot be restricted (admin, rights changed); TDLib answers with an error
effect: Box has already closed with 'Member banned' note; failure surfaces only in member_action_error of the member dialog if it happens to be open
fix: Hold the dialog in a Sending(request id) stage and close it on the matching answer.

title: Permissions Save closes silently when nothing was sent
trigger: Change a permission and Save when set_chat_permissions refuses (no right, same request in flight)
effect: save_permissions_box returns Ok(false) for 'nothing differs or the viewer may not save'; the box closes with no note, the change is lost
fix: Distinguish Unchanged from Refused in the return type and keep the box with an error on Refused.

title: Stops slider thumb stays on a value the save refused
trigger: Drag the slow mode (or boosters) slider and release; the change request fails or the permission is refused and the caller's value does not change.
effect: on_change fires once on release; reported equals the caller's value so no resync happens, the thumb and the highlighted label stay on the unsaved stop while the real value is the old one.
fix: Resync the thumb whenever the caller's value differs from the slider's stop, not only when the caller's value changes; or make the pending drag an explicit variant.

title: close_info_panel does not close the pieces opened with the panel
trigger: Open a supergroup info panel (inline members, event-log search field), close it, open a user panel.
effect: Only the driver target and common_groups are reset; inline_members and admin.event_log_search keep their state and the event-log field keeps the old chat's query until the next open syncs it.
fix: Have one InfoPanelUi value that is replaced on open/close and owns these sub-states.

title: Username toggle error from an earlier try shows when the Type box is reopened
trigger: Toggle a username to active when at the limit (error shown), close the Type box, reopen it for the same chat.
effect: Session group_type.toggle_error is a single global slot, cleared only when a new toggle starts, so the old 'too many usernames' line appears on reopen.
fix: Clear the error in open_group_type_box and when the box closes, or keep it inside GroupTypeBox.

title: New community box closes as created on dispatch
trigger: Fill the New community box and press Create; create_community returns Ok(Some) but TDLib then refuses.
effect: The dialog is taken and dropped on the send result, the note says 'Community created'; a later refusal leaves the user with no box and the typed name lost.
fix: Keep the box as Submitting{request} and close it on the answer.

title: Custom title / community name box closes as saved on dispatch
trigger: Edit an admin custom title and press Save; TDLib then rejects the change.
effect: Dialog is dropped when the request is sent and the note says 'Custom title updated'; the rejection arrives later and the typed title is lost.
fix: Hold the box as Editing/Saving{request}/Failed and close it on the answer.

title: Leave/Delete chat reports success and closes the Edit box when the request was only sent
trigger: Confirm Delete chat or Leave chat while TDLib then refuses (not allowed, flood).
effect: Note says 'Chat deleted' / 'Left the chat' and the Edit box is closed at dispatch; the failure (if surfaced) arrives later as a separate error and the box is gone.
fix: Show 'Deleting...' and close the Edit box from the chat's removal update, not from the send result.

title: Topic editor closes as saved when the create/edit request failed
trigger: In the topic editor type a name, press Create/Save while the send fails (driver Err, or no live client).
effect: editor is set to None after the error note, so the typed name and chosen icon are lost and the list shows again as if saved.
fix: Clear the editor only in the Ok arm (or hold it as an enum Editing/Saving/Failed); keep it on Err.

title: Dialog builder asks for topic icon downloads on every build while the editor is open
trigger: Open the topic editor and leave it open.
effect: download_forum_topic_icons runs inside the dialog builder, a render-time side effect; each rebuild re-requests downloads for every icon file.
fix: Request the downloads once in begin_topic_editor (or when the icon list lands), not in the builder.

title: Welcome message text cleared even when the add failed
trigger: Type a welcome message, press Add while the request fails (driver Err or no live client).
effect: new_input is reset to empty after the error note, so the typed message is lost.
fix: Clear the input only in the Ok arm.

title: Welcome message edit closes as saved when the edit failed
trigger: Press Edit on a welcome message, change the text, press Save while the request fails.
effect: editing is set to None after the error note, the edit text is dropped and the row shows the old text as if saved.
fix: Leave editing set on Err; model the dialog row as Viewing/Editing{id}/Saving{id}.

title: The block is reset only when the group changes, not each time the panel opens
trigger: Open the info panel of group A, scroll and fail a page, close it, reopen A.
effect: shown, failed_offset, admins_asked and the snapshot are kept from the last visit (inline_members.chat is never cleared on close), so a failed page or the administrators fallback stays latched.
fix: Reset (or drop) InlineMembersUi when the info panel target closes; key it by AccountChat.

title: failed_offset is set when the page is requested, so a request that fails to send blocks paging for good
trigger: Scroll the group info members list to its end while the driver call returns Err (no connection).
effect: fetch_supergroup_members_more result is ignored (let _ =) and failed_offset=Some(offset) stays; member_more_failed is never set so retry_at_scroll is not armed. next_more returns Nothing for that offset; the Retry button only shows for an empty list. Cleared only by a membership change or a different group.
fix: enum PageState { Idle, Requested{offset}, Failed{offset} } set to Failed on the Err arm too.

title: Delete-revoked-by-admin alert acts on a bare chat_id and relies on whichever admin page is still open
trigger: Open the alert on another admin's links page, switch account or go back, press Delete
effect: Deletes revoked links on the wrong account/admin, or errors silently
fix: Owned confirmation keyed by OfAccount+admin page; closed by Farewell

title: details_link is set before the members request and the Err of open_chat_invite_link_members is ignored
trigger: Open Group Settings > Invite links, tap a link's details while offline/driver refuses
effect: Block shows Loading... forever (no members page, no error); also two stores (dialog.details_link and session invite_pages.members) kept in step by hand
fix: Make details one enum owned by the page (Closed/Loading/Loaded/Failed) set from the driver result

title: Delete-all-revoked alert is not owned by the account/box and acts on a bare chat_id
trigger: Open Delete all alert, switch account (or close the settings box) then press Delete
effect: delete_all_revoked_chat_invite_links(chat_id) runs against the new account's driver; alert returns true (closes) regardless of result
fix: Open the confirmation through the Asker seam owned by (account, chat); drop it in Farewell

title: Box closes as saved once the request is queued; a later TDLib error loses the typed form
trigger: Create a link that the server rejects (limit, rights)
effect: Box is already gone, error only as a status note; name, dates and fee must be retyped
fix: Keep the box in a Saving stage until the answer, reopen on error

title: Cancel and Esc stay live while the create request is in flight, and the chat is made anyway
trigger: New Channel (or Group), Create, then press Cancel/Esc/X before TDLib answers (the Create button shows loading, Cancel is not disabled: steps.rs new-chat-cancel).
effect: close_new_chat drops the dialog but the request stays out: the chat is created with no Type step (a supergroup/channel never gets its link choice or subscribers step) and, for a channel, with no feedback at all. The Cancel did not cancel.
fix: Disable Cancel/dismiss while the stage is Creating with no outcome, or keep the dialog as a Creating stage that finishes the flow when the answer lands.

title: Edit profile Save closes the box as saved before the server answers; a rejected name or bio error is shown nowhere
trigger: Open Edit profile, type a bio TDLib rejects or a name it refuses, press Save. save_profile_form only checks that the request was queued, sets the 'Name update requested' note and calls close_edit_profile_dialog.
effect: The dialog disappears and the user believes the edit was saved. The failure lands in users_state.profile_edit_error (state/domains/users/error.rs), which only the edit-profile and peer-colour dialogs draw, so it is never seen and the old values come back.
fix: Keep the dialog in a Saving(requests) stage that leaves on the answer (close) or the error (stay open with the error), instead of closing on enqueue.

title: Send Request clears the request box before the send and still jumps to the chat when the send failed
trigger: Open Enable Sharing request box on a private chat, press Send with the connection down.
effect: send_sharing_request: driver.send_sharing_request clears private_sharing.enable before sending; on Err the note shows but the box is gone and select_listed_chat still opens the chat as if the request was sent.
fix: Clear the box only on Ok; keep it open with the error on Err.

title: Every redraw of the statistics panel deep-clones the whole ChatStatistics, so the parsed-chart cache never hits and every graph is re-parsed
trigger: Hover or drag over any chart (ChartState notifies and redraws the panel): chat_statistics.get().cloned() copies every graph's JSON string, so parsed_chart's key (pointer,len) is new each time.
effect: Re-parse of up to ~10 graphs plus deep ChatStatistics equality in ChartState::sync on every hover frame (wasted work on the UI thread).
fix: Hold the loaded statistics in an Rc/Arc and key the chart cache by Rc identity or a content hash.

title: An async graph whose load failed disappears from the panel with no message or retry
trigger: Open statistics; a getStatisticalGraph request fails (flood wait, network). stat_graph_section re-requests only on None; GraphFetch::Failed hits '_ => return None'.
effect: The chart section is silently missing until the whole panel is refreshed (load_stat_graph itself would resend on Failed but is never called).
fix: Render Failed as a section with the error and a Retry button that calls load_stat_graph.

title: Opening a story's statistics sets the page before the request and keeps it when the send fails
trigger: Click a recent story row with the connection gate inactive; set_page(Story) runs, fetch_story_insights returns Err (note shown).
effect: Story page shows 'Loading statistics' with no state to ever answer it and no retry; only Back leaves.
fix: Set the page only after the fetch is accepted, or insights becomes Fetch with Failed and a Retry.

title: Story statistics Failed state has no Retry (message statistics has one); a failed Retry send is dropped silently
trigger: Story statistics request fails; or Retry on message statistics when the send is refused.
effect: Error text only; user must go back and reopen. Retry Err result is discarded with 'let _ ='.
fix: Retry button for story page; surface Err from retry_message_statistics as a note.
